messages.mock2Subject: Notes on Assignment 3 - Intro to CS
messages.mock2Snippet: I checked your submitted assignment, pay attention to the algorithm efficiency in part B...
messages.mock2Content:
Hello,

The grading for Assignment 3 is complete. Overall the work was very good, but I noticed that in part B you used nested loops which increases time complexity to O(n^2).

Efficiency can be improved by using a Hash Map data structure which will lower complexity to O(n). I recommend reviewing the material from lecture 4 again.

Good luck ahead,
Dr. Amit Shapira

help.subtitle: Here you can find answers to common questions or chat with support.

help.lecturerWelcome: Hello Teaching Staff! How can I help you today?

help.autoReplyLecturer: Thank you very much for your inquiry. An academic support representative will join the chat shortly...
help.faqStudentQ1: How do I submit an appeal for an assignment?
help.faqStudentA1: To submit an appeal, go to the specific assignment page through the assignments list, and click on the 'Submit Appeal' button. Enter the appeal details and submit.
help.faqStudentQ2: When will I get a grade on my assignment?
help.faqStudentA2: After submitting the assignment, it will undergo automatic AI grading which takes a few minutes. Then, the lecturer can approve or change the grade.
help.faqStudentQ3: Can I submit an assignment late?
help.faqStudentA3: Late submission depends on the course and lecturer settings. Some courses have a late penalty, and some do not allow late submissions at all.
help.faqStudentQ4: How do I log in to the system?
help.faqStudentA4: You can log in using your university username and password.
help.faqLecturerQ1: How do I open a new course?
help.faqLecturerA1: You can open a new course from the 'My Courses' tab by clicking the 'Add Course' button.
help.faqLecturerQ2: How do I approve AI-generated grades?
help.faqLecturerA2: Enter the desired assignment, review the suggested grades and click 'Approve Grades' or edit manually if needed.
help.faqLecturerQ3: Can I extend a submission deadline?
help.faqLecturerA3: Yes. In the assignment settings screen you can change the due date or allow late submissions under the 'Late Policy' section.
help.faqLecturerQ4: How do I respond to a student appeal?
help.faqLecturerA4: You will see a notification for open appeals. Enter the assignment via the appeals tab, read the student's claim, add feedback and approve/reject the appeal.

appealReview.title: Review Appeal
appealReview.successDesc: The student will be notified of the grade update and the new feedback.
appealReview.aiScanIdleDesc: Let AI analyze the student's claim against the original submission and recommend an action.
appealReview.aiScanningDesc: Comparing student's claim with the actual implementation
appealReview.mockStudentClaim: The AI deducted 18 points for runtime efficiency in the delete function. However, as can be seen in the attached file, my implementation correctly uses finding the Successor and therefore runs in O(log n) time on average as we learned in class. I would appreciate a re-evaluation of this section.
appealReview.mockFeedbackPositive: The implementation of the insert function is efficient and correct (O(log n) on average).
appealReview.mockFeedbackNegative: The delete function is inefficient in some edge cases and may exceed O(log n).
appealReview.aiAppliedFeedback: After a re-evaluation with the help of AI, it seems you are correct. The implementation of finding the successor indeed guarantees logarithmic running time on average. The grade has been updated accordingly.
appealReview.aiConclusionText: The student's claim is correct. A re-evaluation shows that the helper function prevents overflow in edge cases, and the complexity remains O(log n).
appealReview.aiRejectFeedback: After a thorough review of your claims, the implementation still does not meet the efficiency requirements. The original grade remains.
